supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16 UTC, Explorer wrote a UserAssist registry value whose encoded path decodes to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This indicates a PowerShell launch was recorded, but it does not establish that this was the launch reported around 13:40.
Around 13:40 UTC, proxy records show ivy.chen's Chrome browser accessing Salesforce login-page content. These records do not identify PowerShell activity or explain the reported window.

known_telemetry_limitations: Sysmon and Windows Security logs for WS-ICHEN-01 were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage. This overlaps the reported time and prevents reviewing process creation, command lines, and related security events on the alerted host during that period.
Proxy, Zeek connection, and DNS sensors were reported operational, but the available network records do not identify the process that generated the Salesforce traffic.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell launched around 13:40 UTC, or whether the 14:16 UserAssist entry is related to the reported window.
The PowerShell command line, parent process, script or commands executed, user context at launch, and whether the activity was authorized.
Whether the reported window was benign administrative or user activity, or malicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover endpoint process, PowerShell operational, and script-block logs for WS-ICHEN-01 during 13:30–14:10 UTC, if available from local retention or another collection source.
Review EDR or other endpoint telemetry for PowerShell launches, command lines, parent processes, and related file or network activity around 13:40 UTC.
Ask ivy.chen whether they launched PowerShell and what task they were performing; compare any explanation with workstation patching or other authorized activity.
unrelated_findings: The proxy recorded a DropboxUpdate connection to desktop.dropbox.com from WS-ICHEN-01. Dropbox is not among the listed approved services; review separately. This does not establish that it is related to the PowerShell alert. (T054-00062)
GlobalProtect PanGPA.exe ran under ivy.chen's account on WS-ICHEN-01. The inventory says there is no VPN; verify this software separately. (T054-00069, T054-00070)
Cisco AnyConnect vpnagent.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-ICHEN-01. The inventory says there is no VPN; verify this software separately. (T054-00372, T054-00373)
